title: Tiny-HR: Towards an interpretable machine learning pipeline for heart rate estimation on edge devices
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of an ML pipeline for heart rate estimation. While it mentions the implications of false inferences in medical devices and design choices for system reliability, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of the study. These mentions are brief and relate to the practical robustness and safety of the system, not a deeper philosophical or ethical inquiry.
